item.title: Overpopulation is a major factor in global mortality
item.description: In many countries, overpopulation, poverty and lack of food increase hunting of wildlife for ”bush-meat” and other products.

item.title: Restoring Nature Is Our Only Climate Solution
item.description: Why there is no viable techno-fix to climate change, and why trees, soil, and biodiversity are our real lifelines.

item.title: America at the Mirror’s Edge
item.description: A few nights ago, I was forced to admit that I had exhausted my store of ideas for a way out of the Trumpian nightmare.

item.description: “MAGA abortion bans are killing our wives, mothers, sisters, and daughters,” said nonprofit progressive advocacy group DemCast.

item.title: What were the key moments in your life?
item.description: My contention is that each phase affords the life traveler the unique chance to practice for the next phase.

item.title: When the State Becomes the Mob: The Killing of Alex Pretti

item.title: When the State Becomes the Occupied: A Warning from American History
item.description: Consider whether America has before been through anything like the terror that ICE is leveling across this nation at this moment.
